rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The Chief Cabinet Secretary's press record of the afternoon of 16 September 2009, in which 平野博文 introduced himself as the incoming Chief Cabinet Secretary and announced the list of ministers of the Hatoyama cabinet (鳩山内閣), says the Prime Minister's press conference was scheduled for 18:00, the Imperial appointment ceremony and attestation (親任式及び認証式) for 19:00 and the first cabinet meeting for 21:40.
